notes:
Account summary: Stalled / effectively closed-lost for current procurement window. Paid pilot never kicked off — POC not started. Primary reasons: no internal champion (ops director left in Sep), security insisted on an air-gapped option and long timeline for certs, and procurement instituted a fiscal freeze for Q4. Competitor CloudForge AI won initial purchase for a limited pilot (on-prem variant they already had).

Key contacts:
- CTO: Anya Voss (technical sponsor initially; deprioritized after re-org)
- Head of Field Ops: Marcus Liu (wanted fast pilot but no infra resources)
- Procurement: Jenna Ross (procurement freeze, asks for multi-vendor RFP)

Timeline / activity log:
- 2024-08-02: Inbound lead from webinar; AE (Maya) intro call 08/10 — good fit on field tech assistant use case.
- 2024-09-02: Sec checklist call (Diego + security SME) — asked for SOC2, ISO27001, KMS and on-prem air-gap option. Fireflies ff-2024-09-02-0034.
- 2024-10-05: Sent pricing + dedicated capacity proposal (deck link).
- 2024-11-12: Procurement emails — announced budget freeze across manufacturing BU.
- 2025-02-14: Learned they ran a proof with CloudForge AI (short pilot) — competitor reported as preferred vendor due to legacy relationship.
- 2025-07-21: Re-engagement call to explore Private offering; good technical alignment but infra team cannot commit to timeline (ff-2025-07-21-0192).
- 2025-11-18: Security raised additional control request: formal HSM/KMS integration and longer retention SLA; asked for legal redline.
- 2026-02-02: AE follow-up — procurement confirms freeze still in place, no budget for new pilots this FY.

Why POC never started:
- Could not align on success criteria — ops wanted KPIs tied to time-on-tool and MTTR improvement but engineering sponsor wanted accuracy-first metrics; no single owner to arbitrate.
- Infra resourcing: field infra team prioritized SAP/OT upgrades; no headcount to stand up Private cluster.
- Security timeline mismatch: security required air-gapped deployment and custom KMS workflow; Redwood Private offered but legal and infra timeline exceeded their procurement window.
- Budget/policy: procurement freeze then decision to run small pilot with incumbent that required fewer integration points.

Sales notes / AE perspective:
- Good technical match and clear ROI case for field technician time savings.
- Strong initial enthusiasm from Field Ops but lack of executive sponsor after re-org.
- Competitor won a trimmed-down pilot by leveraging existing on-prem appliance relationship — reduced integration asks.

Next steps (recommended):
- Close as lost for current fiscal window; tag account for re-touch in 6-9 months.
- Save all security artifacts and send a one-page summary of Redwood Private capabilities and compliance milestones to procurement (attach existing SOC2/ISO docs).
- If procurement opens or security deprioritizes air-gap, re-engage Diego + Maya to propose minimal-scope "starter POC" (cloud-hosted, strict VPC + KMS) to prove value faster.

Quote snippets from calls:
- "We like the ROI math but we can't staff the infra work right now." — Marcus Liu (Field Ops)
- "Security won't sign off without air-gap proof and HSM flow documented." — Jenna Ross (Procurement)
